versions.content: A successful pa rtial foreground test shall set the block specific result to RAMTST_RESULT_OK. It shall not modify the overall test result. A failing partial foreground test shall set both, the block specific as well as the overall test result to RAMTST_RESULT_NOT_OK.

A successful partial foreground test shall set the block specific result to RAMTST_RESULT_OK. It shall not modify the overall test result. A failing partial foreground test shall set both, the block specific as well as the overall test result to RAMTST_RESULT_NOT_OK.
